entries.title: Jeremiah 30:1
segments: ¶The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:2
segments: "Thus speaks the LORD God of Israel, saying: 'Write in a book for yourself all the words that I have spoken to you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:3
segments: 'For behold, the days are coming,' says the LORD, 'that I will bring back from captivity My people Israel and Judah,' says the LORD. 'And I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:4
segments: Now these [are] the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and Judah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:5
segments: "For thus says the LORD: 'We have heard a voice of trembling, Of fear, and not of peace.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:6
segments: Ask now, and see, Whether a man is ever in labor with child? So why do I see every man [with] his hands on his loins Like a woman in labor, And all faces turned pale?

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:7
segments: Alas! For that day [is] great, So that none [is] like it; And it [is] the time of Jacob's trouble, But he shall be saved out of it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:8
segments: 'For it shall come to pass in that day,' Says the LORD of hosts, '[That] I will break his yoke from your neck, And will burst your bonds; Foreigners shall no more enslave them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:9
segments: But they shall serve the LORD their God, And David their king, Whom I will raise up for them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:10
segments: ¶'Therefore do not fear, O My servant Jacob,' says the LORD, 'Nor be dismayed, O Israel; For behold, I will save you from afar, And your seed from the land of their captivity. Jacob shall return, have rest and be quiet, And no one shall make [him] afraid.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:11
segments: For I [am] with you,' says the LORD, 'to save you; Though I make a full end of all nations where I have scattered you, Yet I will not make a complete end of you. But I will correct you in justice, And will not let you go altogether unpunished.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:12
segments: "For thus says the LORD: 'Your affliction [is] incurable, Your wound [is] severe.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:13
segments: [There is] no one to plead your cause, That you may be bound up; You have no healing medicines.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:14
segments: All your lovers have forgotten you; They do not seek you; For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, With the chastisement of a cruel one, For the multitude of your iniquities, [Because] your sins have increased.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:15
segments: Why do you cry about your affliction? Your sorrow [is] incurable. Because of the multitude of your iniquities, [Because] your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:16
segments: 'Therefore all those who devour you shall be devoured; And all your adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; Those who plunder you shall become plunder, And all who prey upon you I will make a prey.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:17
segments: For I will restore health to you And heal you of your wounds,' says the LORD, 'Because they called you an outcast [saying]: "This [is] Zion; No one seeks her."'

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:18
segments: ¶"Thus says the LORD: 'Behold, I will bring back the captivity of Jacob's tents, And have mercy on his dwelling places; The city shall be built upon its own mound, And the palace shall remain according to its own plan.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:19
segments: Then out of them shall proceed thanksgiving And the voice of those who make merry; I will multiply them, and they shall not diminish; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:20
segments: Their children also shall be as before, And their congregation shall be established before Me; And I will punish all who oppress them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:21
segments: Their nobles shall be from among them, And their governor shall come from their midst; Then I will cause him to draw near, And he shall approach Me; For who [is] this who pledged his heart to approach Me?' says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:22
segments: 'You shall be My people, And I will be your God.'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:23
segments: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD Goes forth with fury, A continuing whirlwind; It will fall violently on the head of the wicked.

entries.title: Jeremiah 30:24
segments: The fierce anger of the LORD will not return until He has done it, And until He has performed the intents of His heart. In the latter days you will consider it.
